hook_secret.description: The Send Email Hook secret, starting with v1,whsec_. Supabase generates it under Authentication, Hooks, Send Email hook. Leave it out to keep the stored secret.

supabase_url.description: The Supabase project URL, such as https://abcdefgh.supabase.co, from the project's API settings in the Supabase dashboard. It must use https.

templates.description: Supabase email action type to the id of the email template that sends it. Each template must be transactional and marked sensitive. This replaces the whole mapping: include every type to keep, and leave a type out to unmap it. A core auth email with no template fails in Supabase, and a notification with no template is skipped. Valid action types: signup, invite, magiclink, email, recovery, email_change, reauthentication, password_changed_notification, email_changed_notification, phone_changed_notification, identity_linked_notification, identity_unlinked_notification, mfa_factor_enrolled_notification, mfa_factor_unenrolled_notification.
